title: 18 March 1965: Filming: Help!, Austria
content:
The Beatles filmed scenes for Help! at three locations in Obertauern, Austria, on this day: at an Olympic ski jump, on the ski slopes, and in an après-ski cellar.

In the evening John Lennon and Paul McCartney took part in a jam session at the Marietta Hotel in Obertauern.

Page last updated: 17 September 2021

  • 1976: Press launch for Wings At The Speed Of Sound
  • 1976: Jim McCartney dies
  • 1975: Cover photoshoot: Venus And Mars by Wings
  • 1973: Wings live: Hard Rock Cafe, London
  • 1973: Television: James Paul McCartney
  • 1972: Recording, mixing: Sisters, O Sisters, The Luck Of The Irish, Angela, Woman Is The N****r Of The World, Born In A Prison by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1971: Recording: Too Many People, Ram On by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1969: George and Pattie Harrison appear in court on drugs charges
  • 1968: US single release: Lady Madonna
  • 1965: Lennon and McCartney jam in Obertauern, Austria
  • 1964: Radio: The Public Ear
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Regal Cinema, Gloucester
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
